_doc: Field reference for the step ledger produced by latexmath.ledger.build_ledger. Flat entity lists with stable ids, cross-linked by id. Both verifying-proofs and explaining-derivations read this and nothing else.

source.root: absolute path of the document's root .tex
source.files: every file reached through \input/\include, document order

macros.name: macro name without the leading backslash
macros.is_math: false for cross-reference and citation helpers, whose bodies are prose

macros_unexpandable: names that survived the depth cap; each is a reason a step may be opaque

claims.kind: theorem | lemma | proposition | corollary | definition | assumption | claim | ...
claims.env: the LaTeX environment name as written
claims.label: \label value, or null
claims.number: printed number from its counter, or null when starred
claims.title: optional-argument title, or null
claims.hypotheses: list of hypothesis clauses; EMPTY when split_method is unsplit
claims.conclusion: conclusion clause, or the whole statement when unsplit
claims.split_method: then | if-then | unsplit -- a split is NEVER guessed
claims.duplicate_of: id of the earlier claim this restates, or null
claims.hypotheses_diff: ['-dropped', '+added'] against the original; non-empty is a finding

proofs.claim_id: the claim it discharges, or null
proofs.attachment: explicit-arg | adjacent | none -- how it was bound, so a report can say

base_case.variable: induction variable if it was named

structure.hedges: hedging phrases found in the proof body

steps.kind: chain-row | display | inline-assert | prose-move | case-open | narration | qed
steps.container: id of the equation this step lives in, or null
steps.prose_tex: the sentence that justifies the step, including any merged narration

justification.kind: named-result | internal-ref | citation | assumption | definition | none
justification.name: catalogue key when kind is named-result

steps.assumptions_in_scope: ids of assumption claims stated before this proof

side_conditions.kind: nonzero-denominator | log-argument-positive | even-root-nonnegative | invertible | limit-interchange | differentiate-under-integral

steps.content_hash: identity of the step: tokens, not layout

rows.lead_relation: relation this row opens with, or null

refs.forward_refs: informational: legal LaTeX and ordinary practice
refs.cycles: claim-level dependency cycles; each is a CRITICAL needing no computer algebra

symbols.defined_at: span of the declaration, or null
symbols.domain_hint: real | positive | natural | unit-interval | unit-interval-half-open | positive-definite | invertible | probability-distribution | ... or null
symbols.domain_provenance: declared | inferred | user-supplied | unknown -- ONLY the first three may license a refutation

domain_evidence.quote: the sentence the domain was read from

coverage.opacity_histogram: reason -> count; printed at the head of every report and often the finding itself
coverage.proof_text_captured_pct: below 90 means the segmenter dropped content and nothing downstream is trustworthy
